headline: Vista Bank, with €17 million in bonds listed on the Stock Exchange, updates its issuance program with a €100 million ceiling
summary: Vista Bank Romania approved an update to its corporate bond issuance programme, with a maximum nominal value of €100 million. The bank has €17 million in bonds already listed on the stock exchange.
why: Bond issuance programmes let banks raise funds from investors, and their size signals the bank's funding capacity.
